items.title: 67750_Sippie Wallace oral history interview
items.q: I thought Vicky would go -- I thought she was going to London... Vicky didn't make the date. And so they sent for me.

ctx.x: No, she had been and I thought Vicky would go -- I thought she was going to London, but no, she had been the year before then.
Oh, I see. So they wanted somebody new.
